distractors: answering the sample proportion 7/10 and ignoring the prior
prose: A coin has an unknown probability theta of landing heads. Before observing any data, theta is given a Beta prior with first shape parameter 1 and second shape parameter 3. The coin is then tossed 10 times, independently, and 7 heads are observed.
question: What is the numerical value of the posterior mean of theta?
reference_hml:
module BetaBinomial

param theta : Probability
prior theta ~ Beta(alpha := 1, beta := 3)

obs trials : Natural = 10
obs successes : Natural = 7

likelihood successes | theta ~ Binomial(trials := trials, prob := theta)

infer posterior theta

prohibited_assumptions: that the prior is uniform when it is not
